title: Michael half-recognizes Doty from a photo

tellings.quote: I see a I I can't picture him, but I see I see a guy like him.

plain: Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran who says he and his partner were abducted in 1977 while guarding missiles at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, is shown a photo of Richard Doty, a man whose name comes up often in UFO stories, and half-recognizes him. "I can't picture him, but I see a guy like him," Johnson tells Michels. If the memory is real, it would tie Doty to what happened to Johnson after the incident.
